source_review.probability_semantics: pminus and pplus are converted to exact Fractions; r and q are computed exactly before binary64 enclosure. Enclose_fraction compares the exact rational to Fraction(float(value)) and moves only a needed endpoint.
source_review.binomial_normalization: A mode has relative unnormalized mass1. Exact adjacent ratios are<=1 away from a mode, and positive interval multiplication encloses every relative mass. Their total is at least1, so max(1,total_lo) is a valid strengthened lower total. Dividing lower mass by total_hi and upper mass by total_lo gives valid pmf intervals.
source_review.point_operations: Under correctly rounded IEEE-754 binary64 basic arithmetic and gradual underflow, one nextafter step outward bounds each operation; clipping a negative lower endpoint to0 is valid for nonnegative quantities. Subnormal positive upper endpoints intentionally persist after numerical zero.
source_review.prefix_sum: For n*eps<1/16, the standard cumulative-addition relative error gamma_(n-1), with unit roundoff eps/2, is strictly below4*n*eps. The n*TINY absolute allowance covers gradual-underflow errors. Outward division by1+relative or1-relative and outward endpoint correction conservatively enclose prefixes. This assumes numpy.cumsum uses no more than n additions on a dependency path.
source_review.sign_dp: The contiguous unabsorbed interval is indexed by origin. Bernoulli transitions reach origin through origin+len(row), then symmetric upper/lower tails absorb first-crossing mass. Sign-only stopping has no direct dependence on physical waiting times.
source_review.waiting_identity: For d>=1 and r>0, E[min(NB(d,r),T)]=(d/r)P(Bin(T+1,r)>=d+1)+T*P(Bin(T,r)<d). The next-tail[2:] and head[:-1] slices correctly match d+1 and d-1 for d=1,...,T.
source_review.waiting_overflow_fix: Divide next-tail by r before multiplying by d. The upper first term may overflow but is safely capped atT; the whole truncated wait is<=T. If a positive exact r has binary64 lower endpoint0, use the rigorous upper waitT directly. The lower tail/rhi cannot overflow for these valid probabilities because its exact value is<= (T+1)/(d+1).
source_review.total_cost: Multiply first-crossing probabilities by truncated waits and add T times sign-survival probability. Multiply pair cost by2. This includes wrong reports and abstentions and agrees with an independent physical-time exact DP.
source_review.abstention: It equals1-P(plus)-P(minus); outward subtractions and probability clipping enclose it. Small floating widths are not empirical uncertainty intervals.
source_review.limitations: Analysis requires stationary independent Bernoulli arms, sign-only frozen boundary and inspection after every physical pair. It does not analyze old sparse checkpoints, adaptive arm selection, or physical-prefix gates. Source-level arithmetic review and finite exact checks are not formal verification of Python/numpy/IEEE execution.
